correctness.rationale: Rank-two logical equivalence is proved via two-round EF games using complete pointed atomic-neighbor masks. The explicit grid and six-cycle have the same mask (120) and opposite commutation; the rank-three relational-composition sentence defines the property. Separate elementary arguments exclude 1- or 2-point counterparts and any noncommuting three-point structure with a commuting counterpart at arbitrary size. Direct game calculation confirms the main witness.
